rendererConstraint: SpriteRenderer quads are fixed at 16×16; larger frames are not used.
discardedSourceFrames: Per direction: idle bob, walk bob, and dedicated right-facing row (engine mirrors left). Only stand/walk phase 0/1 are kept.
scale: Shared opaque bbox across needed frames sets one max-fit scale (never upscale). Each frame is cropped to its own pixels, scaled with nearest-neighbor only, and placed on the shared pivot.
